name: design-os-3d-blender
description: Parametric 3D mechanical parts generator, headless Blender Python (`bpy`) pipeline, and embedded Three.js CAD showcase engine.

interface.shortDescription: Parametric 3D mechanical parts generator, headless Blender Python (`bpy`) pipeline, and embedded Three.js CAD showcase engine.
interface.longDescription: Generate dimensionally accurate gears, enclosures, drone frames, and exploded mechanical assemblies from plain-English specs or JSON parameters, complete with glTF/STL exports and interactive browser inspection.
defaultPrompt: Generate a parametric 24-tooth helical gear and mounting bracket in headless Blender and export glTF + STL artifacts.
Build an interactive Three.js CAD viewer page with exploded-view scrubbing, wireframe toggle, and orthographic camera presets.
Audit the exported mesh topology for non-manifold edges, zero-area faces, and bounding-box dimensional tolerances.
